cases.F_definition: One-half of reported 40 nm BL pitch (directional planar half-pitch); orthogonal SSL pitch is 750 nm; not 32 nm CMOS peripheral node

source_refs.locator: PDF p2 Section II-A / Fig1: BL pitch 40 nm, SSL pitch 0.75 um, three SSLs, 32 WLs, 13824 BL x 32 WL x 3 SSL physical cells
PDF p1 Section II(b): measured chip is 16-layer 64Gb SLC SGVC

notes: The source geometry is the NAND-04 author model, not a measured 500-layer device.
NAND-04 reports a 32-layer model but cites NAND-05 as 32-layer; NAND-05 itself states measured 16-layer. Preserve 32 as source-model L0, do not relabel it measured.
The 13824*32*3 cell formula establishes one independent bit per BL/SSL/WL site; no extra gain for SGVC walls or pillars.
Excludes macro staircase, edge, global control and I/O overhead; fixed lateral cell-grid folding only.
The 500-layer capacity projection is separate from the current throughput implementation; no timing or manufacturability validation.
cases.geometry_formula: A_xy = 0.040 um * 0.750 um; b_L0 = one site/layer * 32 active WL layers

projection.rule: Keep A_xy fixed, replace b=32 with b=500; equivalently a_500=a_32*32/500 exactly once

definition.metric_scope: Native binary repeated storage cell or minimum tile; not effective INT8 weight density or complete macro/chip density
definition.area_boundary: Native binary repeated cell/tile including access, in-cell circuits, contacts and local wiring. Macro ADC, reduction, pumps, I/O and global control are excluded; any unavoidable tile-local shared circuits are retained and listed.
definition.missing_values: null in JSON, empty in CSV, N/A in charts; never zero
definition.slc_policy: Each independently programmable storage element is capped at one bit; forced-complement MRAM pair has one independent bit
definition.normalization_policy: F_kind explicitly separates nominal_node from directional physical half_pitch; absent F gives N/A only to alpha
definition.precision_policy: 50-digit Decimal arithmetic is retained in exact_decimal and CSV; numerical precision is not evidence accuracy
